title: Extract Variable

solutions.title: Five named factors, one function
solutions.tradeoff: Five extra lines the function did not have before, and five names to get right - all cost, no new capability, since the arithmetic itself does not change.

reviewFocus: Read only the final `return` line - can you tell what it computes without scrolling up to the const declarations? That is the test the original code failed.
Does `affiliationFeeCents` still sit outside the discount chain, or did an extraction accidentally pull it inside the multiplication?
Is `discountedBase` really one idea, or is it hiding a second Extract Variable - the multiplication chain - that never got split further? Either answer is defensible; the walkthrough should say why.

Did any extraction change evaluation order in a way that could matter if `race.baseFeeCents` were ever a getter with a side effect? It is not here, but the question is worth asking of every Extract Variable.
Would you have named `nonHostSurcharge` around the surcharge or around the discount it is not - i.e. is the true/false direction of the ternary the one a reader expects?
